study: Read both %R lines, the gap, and their history against the next 3 minutes. The fit may see only the earlier sessions. The later sessions are the check.
registered_at: 2026-10-18, before any return of this rule was computed.
origin: Operator 2026-10-18: the investigation should read the indicator off the tape. It should not start from a shape picked off a chart. The use of the indicator is to predict the next few minutes. This is that reading. It is not a rerun of the 10-minute path test, and it is not the hand-picked sooner-open cell.
what_a_session_is: Every bet is intraday. The lines are read at the close of a minute, and the return is the next 3 minutes of that same session. The sessions are split only so the check is not the same minutes the fit already saw. Half A, sessions on or before 2026-07-23, is where the score is fit. Half B, sessions after 2026-07-23, is the check. A pattern that shows up only on the fitting sessions is not the call.

same_page.gap: Fast line minus slow line, in points. It is not stored as its own linear column, because that column is exactly the difference of the two lines and the fit would have no unique answer. The squared gap is kept, so a tight pair can differ from a wide pair. Gap history is the two lines at each earlier time.
same_page.history: Both lines now, 3 minutes ago, 5 minutes ago, 15 minutes ago, 30 minutes ago, and at the previous session's last causal minute. The 5-minute together term is the product of the two 5-minute changes. The path inside a lag is not a separate input.
same_page.columns: Fourteen columns, in this order, plus an intercept: fast0, slow0, fast3, slow3, fast5, slow5, fast15, slow15, fast30, slow30, fastP, slowP, gap0sq, together5. Each line is divided by 100 before it is stored. gap0sq is the square of (fast0 minus slow0) on those scaled lines. together5 is the product of the two 5-minute changes on those scaled lines. The fit uses this list and nothing else. A rank-deficient fit does not drop a column. It is UNDERPOWERED.
same_page.forward: Read at the close of minute m. The return starts at the SIP open of minute m+1 and ends at the SIP close of minute m+3. A later minute is not an input.
same_page.the_score: One weighted line, fit on half A only. Each minute on a day has equal total weight with each other day. The check is the minutes on half B whose score is at or above the 80th percentile of the half-A scores. That percentile is frozen on A and applied once.
same_page.pictures: Slopes, 10-point bins, the bottom 20% of the score, the share of check minutes that rose, and the 3 bp and 10 bp lines are pictures. A hot bin is not a second call. Promoting one is a new prereg.
same_page.causation: The lines are computed from prices already printed. The check can show that the score points the same way as the next 3 minutes. It cannot show that the lines cause the move.

data: Same warehouse and sample as the path test: 119 sessions 2026-04-28..2026-10-15, 400 names per session seeded sha256(day|prescreen-sample), names with today's IEX, today's SIP, and the previous session's IEX. The parent list is the prior day's liquid names, not today's watchlist. IEX for the lines, SIP for the return. A SIP result is not assumed to transfer to an IEX fill. Lines warmed on the previous session. The causal minute grid from the path test is reused: at most 14 flat minutes forward from a real print, no look at the next print, no overnight fill. A name is not dropped because of how many bars the finished day has. The run refuses unless n = 119, first = 2026-04-28, last = 2026-10-15, and the median split is 2026-07-23.
window: Minutes 10:00 through 15:56 ET. 10:00 is the first minute with a 30-minute history inside the regular session. 15:56 is the last minute whose 3-minute return ends on the 15:59 close.
call: One call, on the held-out upper slice, on the next 3 minutes, gross. DIRECTION only if half B has gross > 0, day-clustered t >= 1.5, excess versus the other minutes that day > 0 with t >= 1.5, and excess versus the other names at that same minute > 0 with t >= 1.5, with at least 30 slice-days, 30 excess days, 30 cross days, and 1000 slice-minutes. Half B is sessions after 2026-07-23. Half A is the fit and is not the call. A missing t, a short slice, a rank-deficient fit, or indicator failures above 1% of sampled name-days is UNDERPOWERED. Anything else is NO DIRECTION. There is no PASS. DIRECTION means the held-out minutes the score ranked highest did rise, on average, over the next 3 minutes. It does not change config. 10 bp and 3 bp are printed and are not the call.
why_not_a_later_minute_control: Scoring every minute makes a later minute of the same name overlap a 3-minute hold. The controls are the other minutes that day, and the other names at the same minute.
no_retuning: The feature list, the 3-minute return, the 80th percentile, the fit on A, the single check on B, the window, the sample, and the 2026-07-23 split are fixed. A different hold, a hand-picked shape, or a call on a bin is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY, and only then: scp tools/studies/pr_read.py and tools/studies/pr_path.py to /tmp, then REPO=$PWD nice -n 19 .venv/bin/python /tmp/pr_read.py --score. No pytest over SSH. No config edit.
